# News candidates — auto-generated, do not edit by hand

Emitted by `scripts/news/emit-candidate-digest.mjs` from the last 72h
of `news_story`. Regenerated by the `news-worker` workflow after every ingest
cycle; hand edits are overwritten.

**This is a raw candidate list, NOT a filing queue.** No editorial judgment has
been applied: tabloid churn, third-party private lives, and privacy-redlined
material are all still present. News Triage applies the filing bar and
`docs/content-ops/privacy-redlines.md`; a headline appearing here is not a
reason to author it.

**Source-URL caveat — read before citing anything.** Items ingested from the
Google News feeds carry an opaque `news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi...` redirect
as their URL, and `outlet_name` is the search feed, not the publisher. Those are
NOT citable Vault sources. The real publisher is usually visible at the end of
the summary or title (`... parade.com`, `... - Forbes`). Before filing, resolve
the actual article URL on the publisher's own domain and cite that. If you
cannot resolve it, the item does not meet the sourcing bar — say so rather than
filing a redirect link.

**Clustering caveat.** The worker's dedupe does not cluster across outlets, so
`source_count` is 1 almost everywhere and the same event repeats under different
headlines. Group these yourself before judging corroboration — do not read
`verification_status: rumor` as "this is a rumor", it mostly means "one outlet
so far".
